## Checklist / 检查清单

- [ ] The official DSH payload remains pinned and unmodified. / 官方 DSH 载荷仍精确锁定且未修改。
- [ ] No credentials, `$DSH_HOME`, build output, or signing material is committed. / 未提交凭据、`$DSH_HOME`、构建产物或签名材料。
- [ ] User documentation is updated in English and Chinese when applicable. / 如果影响用户，已同步更新中英文文档。
- [ ] Packaging, lifecycle, updater, security, and compatibility risks are stated. / 已说明打包、生命周期、更新器、安全和兼容性风险。
